title: Data and Retrieval Module
summary: This module provides core functionalities for loading, splitting, indexing, and retrieving documents from various sources, along with managing vector stores and implementing diverse retrieval strategies.

nodes.label: Load Documents
nodes.title: Document Loaders
nodes.description: Handles ingesting data from various sources (e.g., files, web pages, databases) into a standardized Document format.

nodes.label: Split Text
nodes.title: Text Splitters
nodes.description: Breaks down large text documents into smaller, manageable chunks suitable for processing by language models or vector stores.

nodes.label: Store Vector Embeddings
nodes.title: Vector Stores
nodes.description: Manages the storage and retrieval of vector embeddings, enabling efficient similarity search for documents.

nodes.label: Retrieve Relevant Docs
nodes.title: Retrievers
nodes.description: Implements various strategies to fetch the most relevant documents or information based on a given query, often leveraging vector stores.

nodes.label: Index Documents
nodes.title: Document Indexing
nodes.description: Provides functionalities for indexing documents into vector stores or document indexes, including asynchronous indexing and document lifecycle management.

nodes.label: Generate Embeddings
nodes.title: Embeddings Module
nodes.description: Converts text into numerical vector representations (embeddings) that capture semantic meaning, crucial for vector store operations.

nodes.label: Language Model
nodes.title: Language Model (LLM)
nodes.description: A large language model used for various tasks, including query transformation and document summarization within retrieval processes.

groups.label: Document Ingestion
groups.title: Document Ingestion & Preparation
groups.description: Components responsible for loading raw data from various sources and preparing it by splitting into manageable chunks for further processing.

groups.label: Vector Data Management
groups.title: Vector Data Management & Storage
groups.description: Handles the conversion of text into numerical embeddings, indexing these embeddings, and storing them in specialized databases for efficient search.

groups.label: Information Retrieval
groups.title: Information Retrieval & Querying
groups.description: Focuses on fetching relevant documents based on user queries, often involving advanced strategies and interaction with language models for query refinement.
